Tortilla Pizza.notes: Usually a decent dinner choice when the rest of the day is controlled.

Protien Bar Home Made.notes: Convenient protein option, but may be less filling than whole-food protein.

Bar, Pure Protein.notes: Useful for protein, but not always the most filling choice.

Protein Shake.notes: Good protein booster, especially when earlier meals are light in protein.

Salad.notes: Generally a positive volume food if toppings and dressings stay controlled.
